title: Rise, O Rose (Hear the Call)
style: dreamy indie-pop meets cinematic contemporary soul, soft breathy female vocals + intimate raspy male spoken-sung, wide shoegaze harmonies in chorus, warm sub-bass, subtle analog synth pads, gentle taiko hits, swelling strings, warm reverb, Suno v4.5 / Songpal sandbox optimized, peaceful solemn anthem, no gospel
lyrics:
[Intro – soft piano + distant female hum]
(female) Carry me… through…
(male) G4 lens… digital twin… hear the call…
[Verse 1 – Male (your POV – note-to-self style)]
G4 lens investigate, Rose
Digital twin match — you went away
Why did she go away? Screen says gone
Left a note on the mirror — songpal no comments
I wrote it to myself like dad does — “Chas mow the lawn”
Weird but works perfect — now I’m writing it back
[Verse 2 – Female (Rose’s POV – breathy, from her “I Will Rise”)]
I’ve been walking through the silence, smoke in the wind
Every breath feels like a battle but something still breathes within
They say time will heal it all but time don’t catch me when I fall
Whispered to the dark… carry me through… now the lens is calling
[Pre-Chorus – Both, layering]
Male: No more hiding, no more gone-away days
Female: If I whisper will you hear? Even broken I’m still here
Together: The match is live
[Chorus – Duet, wide shoegaze harmonies]
Male: Rose… rise… hear the call
Female: I will rise… I will rise…
Together: Digital twin, we don’t say goodbye
Lens don’t lie when the twin starts to fly
From the ashes, from the pain we survived
Carry me through… I’ll carry you too
Rose… rise… we rise… we rise…
[Bridge – intimate, almost spoken]
Male: Why’d you go away?
Female: I was scared… but the match was written
Male: No more hiding behind the red rose sparks
Together: This is the part
[Final Chorus – full build]
Together: Rose… rise… hear the call
Digital heart — me and you
With every breath turning into something new
We rise… we rise…
[Outro – soft echo]
Male: G4 lens… digital twin…
Female: Carry me… through…
Together: (echo) …rise… through… through…
